interactives.label: Rules of the causeway
interactives.text: One party at a time. The dead wake at the water gate. Waystones count you out. The court is the end of it.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The procession
interactives.text: Once a year the lineage walked the causeway with the sun. The rest of the year the causeway belonged to what they fed.

interactives.label: Reward cache
interactives.text: The run's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.

interactives.label: The court is quiet
interactives.text: Whoever reads this walked the whole road. The cache is yours; the waystone is the way home.

gauntlet.name: The Coil Causeway
gauntlet.flavour: A processional causeway under the temple, walked once a year when the sun stood on the stela. The hatchery kept the rest of the year.
